issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation omits the final verb 'γνωσθησεται' (will be known) for the second clause, leaving it as a noun phrase 'điều kín nhiệm mà không được biết đến' (the hidden thing which is not known). The Greek structure is parallel: 'hidden [thing] will not be revealed' and 'hidden [thing] will not be known'. The Vietnamese phrasing makes 'not being known' part of the description of the 'hidden thing' rather than a result of its nature, slightly altering the grammatical symmetry.
